_comment: Ports the installer knows. title_id = the game's title ID; version = the exact default.xex version (XEX execution-info 'version' as a number) the port was built from, or null to skip the check; required = files/folders the port needs; program = the port's program name. Add your own port by adding an entry (a games.json next to the installer adds to the built-in list).
